answer: Graduated reward terraces with rising audit odds: accounts are umber-banded by verified history, and each terrace step up in claimed volume doubles audit probability instead of payout. Claims on a mesa, attested only by same-cluster accounts, stay capped at the lowest band however large. Quartz receipts are carved into the marble ledger, public and immutable. A sybil farm stacking puppets climbs terraces that multiply exposure while mesa isolation caps its total; padding costs linearly against sublinear reward, while honest agents sit low, rarely audited, fully paid.
